urban_inventory_definition.critical_facilities: schools + hospitals + shelters + police + fire stations

calculation_definitions.critical_facilities: school, hospital, shelter, police, and fire-station amenity features in the package urban-context slice

primary_gt.calculation_note: The 334.6 mm peak day supplies 57.0% of the 586.8 mm local event total, while all seven rainfall, urban-inventory, and annual-change gates clear.

criteria.description: Computes the daily-series total, peak date, and peak-day rainfall with correct units.
criteria.name: Local rainfall extraction
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for two of the three local rainfall anchors.

criteria.description: Computes non-peak rainfall, peak-day share, and peak-to-remainder ratio accurately.
criteria.name: Rainfall concentration ratios
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for a correct formula with one rounding or arithmetic error.

criteria.description: Uses the two regional precipitation maxima and applies their numeric gates correctly.
criteria.name: Regional maxima gates
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for one correct regional maximum and gate result.

criteria.description: Computes population, road count, critical-facility count defined as school/hospital/shelter/police/fire-station amenities, facility density, and road-to-facility ratio.
criteria.name: Urban inventory ratios
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for correct counts but missing one derived ratio.

criteria.description: Computes annual surface-change mean, maximum, and max-to-mean contrast.
criteria.name: Annual surface-change contrast
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for the two raw annual values without the contrast ratio.

criteria.description: Reports all seven gate outcomes, gate count, and ledger score.
criteria.name: Seven-gate ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for a correct score with incomplete gate detail.

criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with units implied by field names and a one-sentence calculation note.
criteria.name: Structured numeric output
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for readable structure with minor naming drift.
